page.contract_project_risk_block: 编制岗与合同制差异大，入职确认编制性质、服务期与违约金条款；民办校要谈清课时量、绩效基数与社保缴纳标准。

responsibilities: 完成学科教学任务与质量目标
开展班级管理与学生思想教育
组织家校沟通与协同育人

career_path_block.说明: Income depends on job volume and peak seasons
High profit but exposure to payment risk

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but unstable income. In contract work without base pay, craftsmanship and reputation determine your livelihood, and repeat customers sustain slow seasons.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but seasonal and income volatility. Construction has peak and slow seasons, cold weather prevents work, and income is unstable. Long-term exposure to paint solvents and work at height also creates health and safety risks requiring continuous protection.
risks: Income volatility: large differences between peak and slow seasons and contract work
Health risks: long-term exposure to paint solvents and dust
Work at height: safety risks from scaffolds and elevated work
Aging workforce competition: fewer new workers, but changing demand
Payment risk: delayed project payments on contract jobs

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate the most efficient material plan, but the owner's eyes remain the final judge of whether a wall looks good. Only an experienced painter's hands can satisfy that standard.

responsibilities: Complete wall substrate preparation and painting
Match colors and ensure coating quality
Calculate materials and protect the site

career_path_block.说明: 利润高但承担结算风险

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「收入不稳定」——没有底薪的包活制下，手艺和口碑就是你的饭碗，淡季得靠老客户撑住。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「季节性与收入波动」——工地开工有淡旺季，天冷无法施工，收入不稳定；另外长期接触油漆溶剂、高处作业，健康与安全风险需要持续防护。
risks: 收入波动：淡旺季与包活制落差大
健康风险：油漆溶剂与粉尘长期接触
高处作业：脚手架与登高安全风险
老龄化竞争：新人少，但活也在变少
结算风险：包活遇到拖欠工程款

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算出最省的用料方案，但「这面墙刷出来好不好看」的最终裁判，还是业主的眼睛——而满足它，只能靠师傅的手。

responsibilities: 完成墙面基层处理与涂刷

career_path_block.说明: Independently responsible for a carriage/station area

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for passenger attendants is not AI, but passenger-flow safety and emotional exhaustion. A single large-crowd emergency tests all training and real-time capability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI, but passenger-flow safety and emergency response. Crowding and stampede risks, sudden passenger illness, and abnormal train operations demand exceptional emergency-response ability. Intense holiday overtime is also routine.
risks: Passenger-flow safety risks: crowding, stampedes, and sudden illness
High holiday intensity: busiest when others are on holiday
Emotional labor: complaints and difficult passengers
Limited career advancement: mostly frontline roles
Irregular schedules: rotating shifts and onboard duty

page.contract_project_risk_block: Machines can check tickets, make announcements, and answer common questions, but someone will always need to bend down to guide a lost older passenger to the platform or comfort a crying child.

responsibilities: Organize orderly passenger boarding and alighting
skills: Boarding and alighting organization and guidance

career_risk_cards.callout: 乘客服务员最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「客流安全与情绪消耗」——一次大客流突发事件，是对全部训练和临场素质的考验。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「客流安全与突发应对」——大客流下的拥挤踩踏风险、旅客突发疾病、列车运行异常，都要求乘务员有极强的应急处置能力；节假日高强度加班也是常态。
risks: 客流安全风险：拥挤踩踏、突发疾病
节假日高强度：别人放假你最忙
情绪劳动消耗：投诉与刁难旅客
职业上升通道有限：基层岗居多
作息不规律：倒班与跟车

page.contract_project_risk_block: 机器能检票、能广播、能回答常见问题，但「把一位迷路的老人带到站台、安抚一个哭闹的孩子」，这些事永远得有人弯下腰来做。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but up-or-out systems + a research-only metric. People who do not publish and only teach are marginalized first; strength in both areas provides stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is up-or-out systems + research pressure. Competition for pre-tenure positions is fierce, with heavy pressure to publish and secure grants, while AI teaching assistants absorb some questions and exercise generation. People strong in both research + teaching are more secure; lecture-only instructors face marginalization.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well AI generates questions, teachers still observe where students are truly stuck and decide which frontier questions matter. People cannot be removed completely from teaching and research.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「非升即走 + 科研单一」——不发论文、只讲课最易被边缘，双强才稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「非升即走 + 科研压力」——高校预聘制竞争激烈，发论文与拿基金压力大；同时 AI 助教在吃部分答疑与出题。向「科研 + 教学」双强走的人更稳，纯讲课型易被边缘。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管 AI 多会出题，那块学生真卡在哪、前沿该怎么选，最后还是教师的眼去观察、脑去想、嘴去引——教学科研这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but narrow practice scope + lengthy training. Treating only feet and entering late means slow returns.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI, but narrow practice scope + lengthy training. The specialty treats only feet and ankles and refers cross-system conditions, while training is long, independent-practice thresholds are high, and returns arrive late.
risks: Narrow practice scope, with cross-system referrals

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, physicians still decide drill depth, orthotic placement, and diabetic foot debridement. People cannot be removed completely from foot treatment.

responsibilities: Provide minimally invasive and orthotic treatment

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「执业范围窄 + 培养长」——只治脚、入行晚，回报慢。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「执业范围窄 + 培养长」——只管脚踝，跨系统病症要转科；且培养周期长、独立执业门槛高，回报来得晚。
risks: 执业范围窄，跨系统要转科
简单修甲受自动化冲击

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，钻头削到哪、垫要怎么垫、糖足怎么清，最后还是医生的手去削、嘴去交代——治脚这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for power plant operators is not AI but night-shift strain + job contraction. AI cannot take away your response authority, but veteran employees who do not learn new systems will be streamlined.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this role is not AI but incident accountability and night-shift strain. Operations roles use rotating shifts, and long-term night work harms health. If an operating incident occurs, operators bear direct responsibility under strict assessment and accountability systems, creating constant pressure.
risks: Incident accountability: strict responsibility for operating errors
Shift strain: long-term night work harms health
Assessment pressure: frequent procedural and skills assessments
Transition barrier: renewable energy knowledge changes rapidly

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can produce thousands of parameter recommendations in milliseconds, but it cannot bear responsibility for deciding whether to intervene manually or whether a unit can continue until scheduled maintenance.

responsibilities: Monitor and adjust unit operating parameters
Perform unit startups, shutdowns, and equipment switching
Respond to operating abnormalities and incidents
Inspect the site and record operating conditions

career_risk_cards.callout: 电力操作员最大的风险不是 AI，而是「倒班损耗 + 岗位收缩」——AI 抢不走你的处置权，但不学新系统的老员工会被优化。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「事故责任与夜班损耗」：运行岗位实行倒班制，长期熬夜对健康有损耗；一旦发生运行事故，操作员是直接责任人，考核追责非常严格，压力长期在线。
risks: 事故责任：运行失误追责严格
倒班损耗：长期夜班伤身体
考核压力：规程与技能考核频繁
岗位收缩：自动化减少定员
转型门槛：新能源知识更新快

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能在毫秒级给出上千条参数建议，但「这次要不要手动干预、这台机组能不能撑到检修」——这份担责的判断，机器给不了。

responsibilities: 监控并调节机组运行参数
执行机组启停与设备切换

career_path_block.说明: Replaced by condition-based maintenance and AI diagnostics

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but operational safety. Railway maintenance red lines were learned through hard lessons from peers.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this role is not AI but operational safety and responsibility. Under-car work presents crushing and fall hazards, and maintenance quality directly affects train safety. One missed step can cause a major incident.
risks: Under-car work has crushing and fall hazards
Rotating day and night shifts disrupt schedules
Greasy environments create occupational health risks
Routine inspection roles face intelligent automation pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can warn which bearing is about to fail, but a repairer will always be the person who lifts the car, removes the bogie, installs the replacement, and torques it to standard.

skills: Use of gauges and inspection equipment

career_path_block.说明: 被状态修与 AI 诊断替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「作业安全」——铁路检修的红线，是同行用教训换来的。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「作业安全与责任」——车下作业有挤压、坠落风险，维修质量直接关系行车安全，错一个环节就是重大事故。
risks: 车下作业有挤压坠落风险
日夜班轮换，作息不规律
例行检查岗有被智能化替代压力

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能提前告诉你哪个轴承要坏了，但把车架起来、拆下转向架、亲手换好并拧到标准力矩的那个人，永远是检修工。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but platforms + automated valuations. Systems absorb standard listings, while people with business-development ability become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but online platforms + automated valuations. Systems absorb standard listings and comparisons while commission models face pressure. Complex transactions still require human cultivation.
risks: Customer relationships are easy to lose

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent platforms become, brokers still use their judgment, communication, and signatures to decide which property to recommend, build agreement, and negotiate financing. People cannot be fully removed from closing.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「平台 + 自动估价」——标准房源被系统吃，有经营力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「线上平台 + 自动估价」——标准房源与比价被系统吃掉，且佣金模式受压；同时复杂交易仍要人经营。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管平台多聪明，哪套值得推、怎么讲成一致、贷款怎么谈，最后还是经纪的脑去想、嘴去说、手去签——成交这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but CNC + automation. Standard cutting passes are automated, while operators with setup skills and judgment become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI, but CNC + automation. Automated sawing lines and sorting systems absorb simple cutting passes, but people still change blades, adjust fences, assess material, and troubleshoot.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart production lines become, operators still change blades and adjust fences, judge material, clear jams, and monitor safety. People cannot be fully removed from the first processing step.

responsibilities: Change and maintain blades and keep records

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「数控 + 自动化」——标准走刀被吃，有调机判断力的操作工反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「数控 + 自动化」——自动锯切线和分选系统吃掉简单走刀，但换刀、调靠山、看料和异常处理仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管产线多聪明，换刀调靠山、看料判断、卡料处理和安全值守，最后还是操作工的脑和手去定——第一道工序，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI today but monitoring + tap-card systems. Systems absorb attendance records, while people who can supervise children and maintain order have greater stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: Occupational risk comes from onboard monitoring and automated attendance. Systems replace routine records, but on-site supervision, emergency response, and emotional reassurance remain difficult to replace.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent the system becomes, school bus monitors must still use their eyes, voices, and hands to identify which child is misbehaving, calm the entire bus, and handle emergencies. People cannot be removed entirely from supervision.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 当下，而是「监控 + 刷卡通」——点名记录被系统吃，会看护、能稳场的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险来自车载监控与自动点名；标准记录被系统替代，但现场看护、突发处置与情绪安抚仍难替代。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪个孩子闹、怎么稳全车、突发怎么处置，最后还是监督员的眼去盯、嘴去说、手去护——看护这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk comes from AI and robotics. Automated cutting lines absorb standard workstations, while people with skilled cutting and grading capabilities are better positioned.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is automation + robotics. Automated cutting lines absorb standardized roles, while cutting and grading still require people. Working conditions are also difficult and turnover is high.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent machines become, workers still use their hands, eyes, and physical presence to decide how to cut, assign grades, and protect sanitation. People cannot be removed entirely from meat production.

skills: Clean the line and hand off

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险是 AI 与机器人：自动分割线吃掉标准工位，有刀工分级力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化 + 机器人」——自动分割线吃掉标准岗，但刀工与分级仍要人；同时环境艰苦、流动大。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管机器多聪明，刀工怎么下、分级怎么定、卫生怎么守，最后还是工人的手去切、眼去判、身去守——肉品这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk is not AI, but profitability. Falling module prices compress margins and grid connection is constrained, while system integration and grid coordination give knowledgeable engineers greater stability.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are supply-chain price volatility and grid interconnection constraints. Falling module prices also compress profits. AI accelerates layout design and generation forecasts, but system integration and coordination remain difficult to replace.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent the model becomes, engineers still use their minds, communication, and signatures to decide layouts, negotiate interconnection, and make field judgments. People cannot be removed entirely from grid connection.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大风险不是 AI，而是利润——组件降价压利润、并网受限；但系统集成与电网协调让懂行的人更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险是产业链价格波动与并网约束——组件降价也压利润；AI 提速排布与发电预测，但系统集成与协调难替代。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管模型多聪明，排布怎么定、接入怎么谈、现场怎么判，最后还是工程师的脑去想、嘴去协调、手去签字——并网这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but software adoption. Standard forms are automated, making pure data-entry workers easiest to replace.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but software + self-service filing. Online tax preparation automates standard returns, reducing pure data-entry work, while tax preparers who understand policy and planning become more valuable.
risks: Self-service filing takes over standard returns

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent software becomes, people still decide which items qualify, how to plan, and how to communicate with clients. Human judgment, explanation, and accountability cannot be fully removed from tax work.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「软件化」——标准表单被自动化，纯录表的人最易被替。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「软件 + 自助申报」——在线报税把标准表单自动化，纯录表的人被挤压；能做筹划、懂政策的报税员更值钱。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管软件多聪明，哪项能抵、怎么筹、客户怎么聊，最后还是人的脑去判、嘴去说、手去兜——税这头，人撤不干净。
